mathematical_result.name: QFORM-ONE-HEAVY-N3-KERNEL-v1
mathematical_result.scope: One macroscopic physical coordinate plus a two-dimensional minimum-variance Gaussianized complement in exact signature {1,1,-1}; exact finite cap-one Parseval family lies in the current N3 inequalities for a<tau and m>1/tau.
mathematical_result.statement: For Q_a=-aX^2+2sqrt(1-a^2)XB+aB^2+C^2 with arbitrary cap-one X and B,C iid N(0,1/12), the cone-tip conditional kernel K_a(x) is even and strictly decreasing in |x|, so the exact cap-one optimizer is X uniform on [-1/2,1/2]. At a=1, C_-=sqrt(6pi)erf(sqrt(3/2))<97/24<3sqrt(2).
mathematical_result.finite_family: Rows r, m copies b/sqrt(m), m copies c/sqrt(m) give R_m^T R_m=I and exact nonzero spectrum {1,1,-1}; heavy-b 2x2 determinant=-1/m, heavy-c=-a/m, b-c=a/m^2, same-bank determinant=0.
mathematical_result.continuity: proved for the a=1 limiting arbitrary-heavy-law family and inherited for the finite diffuse-bank witness in the partner's stated range; full-target continuity open

partner_result_applied.application: Its weighted local Edgeworth expansion is applied to the two diffuse banks of Q_{1,m}=-X^2+B_m^2+C_m^2, yielding p(0)=C_- - [9e^(-3/2)+(9/4)C_-]/(20m)+O(m^-2), a strictly negative first correction. Its exact rotated witness also gives C_*>=3sqrt(2), hence C_-<3sqrt(2)<=C_*.

unresolved_implication: The exact optimizer formula C(a) for the genuinely coupled interior has not yet been shown uniformly below 3sqrt(2), and cone-tip control does not imply a global output-density bound. Multiple macroscopic shared rows, non-Gaussian surviving coupled components and arbitrary added spectrum remain outside scope.
next_step: Prove a uniform analytic sup_{0<a<1} C(a)<3sqrt(2) for this direct N3 family, or if closed, change mechanism to two macroscopic shared rows / a surviving non-Gaussian coupled component and test off-tip peaks.
